text: Retrieval augmented generation combines a retriever with a language model to ground answers in source documents.
Evaluate RAG systems with precision at k, recall at k and mean reciprocal rank on labeled queries.
Retrieval augmented generation pipelines fetch passages before the model generates a response.
Precision at k measures the fraction of top k retrieved documents that are relevant.
Tiny regression datasets catch retrieval drift quickly without expensive end to end runs.
Citation support checks whether cited documents actually support the generated answer.
Document chunking changes recall because smaller chunks increase index granularity.
Vector search returns approximate nearest neighbors from embedding indexes.
